create_adam_solver: create an Adam solver for approximating Nash equilibria in nonsymmetric games
run_adam_descent_step: run the Adam descent step to update strategy distributions using exploitability gradients
compute_adam_gradients: compute exploitability gradients for each player's strategy distribution
calculate_adam_exploitability: calculate the exploitability of current strategy distributions as average squared norm
convert_logits_to_dist: convert logits to probability distributions using softmax normalization
